final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, AVG(f.rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal, AVG(CASE WHEN f.feerate = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (f.rebrate - f.feerate) / f.feerate END) as avg_ratio FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) as avg_avg_rebtotal FROM step1) SELECT s1.orderslink, s1.ordertune, s1.avg_rebtotal, s1.avg_ratio, s1.avg_rebtotal - s2.avg_avg_rebtotal as difference FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s1.avg_rebtotal > s2.avg_avg_rebtotal AND s2.avg_avg_rebtotal IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
